snippet.title: Angeline Era | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
Learn more about Angeline Era https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920/Angeline_Era/

Ready for a New Kind of Action? In this challenging ""Bumpslash"" Action-Adventure Game, explore a world of Fae, Humans and Angels, with surprises hidden around every corner. Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

Follow news and updates on the Secret Sauce Showcase:
http://obp.gg/secretsauce
Twitter: https://x.com/offbrand_games
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/offbrand.games
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@offbrand-games
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/offbrandgames/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@offbrand_games

offbrand games is partnering with Open Sauce to celebrate all things indie gaming with Secret Sauce! Expect two days (streamed & in-person) of game exhibitions, talks + roundtables from industry voices, and competitions hosted by gaming creators - as well as a premiere trailer showcase with announcements from a bevy of indie developers and publishers.

Learn more about Open Sauce: https://opensauce.com/overview/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/opensaucelive
Discord: https://discord.gg/gQbcWD8hCd
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@sauceplusofficial
Instagram: https://instagram.com/opensaucelive
TIkTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@opensauce
